title: Printed work order names both people, Parts first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create three active staff members for this test at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a first work order for that customer with Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B.
  • Have a second work order for that customer with Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep C.
  • Then turn sales rep C's "Sales Representative" switch off and save (the staff account stays active).
  • Open the first work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's menu.
  2. Click Print Work Order and read the Sales Representative row of the printout.
  3. Open the second work order.
  4. Open the work order's menu.
  5. Click Print Work Order and read the Sales Representative row of the printout.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The row reads "[sales rep B's name] (Parts) · [sales rep A's name] (Labor)".

Step 3:

  • The second work order opens.

Step 4:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The row reads "[sales rep C's name] (Parts, inactive) · [sales rep A's name] (Labor)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11270 (Story 6, Print both representatives on the work order)

  • S6-R2: “When two people hold the two sides, the row reads both, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An inactive person reads "(Parts, inactive)" or "(Labor, inactive)".”
